{{Quote|Hello, citizen! Can you please take me to&mdash;?''"<br />"''Agggh!|Obi-Wan Kenobi inadvertently scares the Arcona pilot|<ref name="Sabotage (comic)">{{TCWComicCite|6.38|Sabotage (comic story)}}</ref>}}
An '''Arcona''' lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. While on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the Arcona was [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] when [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] landed on the vehicle, on his way to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] to stop a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] plot to sabotage the [[Funeral of Halsey|funeral]] of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master [[Halsey/Legends|Halsey]]. Instead of taking Kenobi to the Temple, the Arcona screamed in fright and tipped the airspeeder sideways, knocking Kenobi off the vehicle.
